summary.text: Sheri Biggs is the incumbent Republican U.S. Representative for South Carolina's 3rd District, elected in 2024 to her first term of public office and seeking re-election. A nurse practitioner and Air National Guard officer, she describes a career of more than three decades in health care before entering Congress. According to her campaign website, she is running on a platform she calls "Healing our Nation" as a pro-life, pro-Second Amendment Republican.

paragraphs.text: Earned a Doctor of Nursing Practice from Samford University. Her official House biography says her bachelor's degree, from Carolina Bible College, is in Christian Ministries, and that she has completed advanced coursework at Air War College.

Serves as a Lieutenant Colonel in the Air National Guard. Her official biography says she received the Aerial Achievement Medal and served as a medical crew director on combat and combat-support missions in support of Operation Freedom's Sentinel.

According to her official biography, she has worked more than three decades in health care, as an Intensive Care Unit nurse, a licensed nursing home administrator and a health services consultant, and is a board-certified family nurse practitioner and psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner.

Volunteers with veterans' and first responders' mental health needs, and, according to her official biography, with the Dream Center and other community and veterans organizations; she is a member of Temple Baptist Church in Anderson, where she provides counseling.

Won the 2024 Republican primary runoff for South Carolina's 3rd District over Mark Burns, then won the November 2024 general election over Democrat Bryon Best and Michael Bedenbaugh. The seat was previously held by Jeff Duncan.
Took office in January 2025. Her official biography describes her as the third woman from South Carolina elected to the U.S. House and the first to represent the 3rd District.
Serves on the House Homeland Security, Foreign Affairs, and Science, Space, and Technology Committees.
Her campaign website describes her as a wife and mother who lives in Salem, South Carolina.
